parts.t: Pebble Hill has big lots and quiet streets close to schools. Browse Pebble Hill homes for sale below, and contact me with any questions.
Pebble Hill is a neighbourhood in Tsawwassen. It's mostly detached houses on quiet streets, from older homes to newer rebuilds. Some homes have views.

The shops on 56 Street, Tsawwassen Mills, the beaches and the BC Ferries terminal are all a short drive away. Highway 17 takes you to the rest of the region. Contact me for current Pebble Hill homes for sale and recent sales.
Can't find what you're looking for? Jared can search the full MLS® for you.
